name: Two-Week Core Foundation
description: Deterministic two-week core and supporting-muscle routine starting 2026-03-16.

card_templates.name: Core Day A
card_templates.summary: Anti-rotation and contralateral core activation for hard and rest days.

payload.instructions: Core Day A emphasizes anti-rotation, trunk stiffness, and contralateral coordination. Keep every rep controlled and stop before form degrades.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (horizontal)
exercises.detail: Hips locked forward. Initiate from obliques and control the return.

exercises.label: Pallof press + overhead reach
exercises.detail: Press out cleanly and avoid rib flare during the reach.

exercises.label: Dead bugs
exercises.detail: Keep low back pressed into the floor through every contralateral rep.

exercises.label: Plank shoulder taps
exercises.detail: Fight hip sway while tapping with control.

card_templates.name: Core Day B
card_templates.summary: Anti-extension core work with anterior-chain control.

payload.instructions: Core Day B builds anti-extension strength. Keep your trunk braced and prioritize control over range.

exercises.label: Ab wheel rollouts
exercises.detail: Roll out only as far as you can return without back sagging.

exercises.label: Hanging leg raises
exercises.detail: Control the descent and initiate by tilting the pelvis.

exercises.label: Body saw plank
exercises.detail: Use a small range and keep the core locked as the lever arm lengthens.

exercises.label: Hollow body hold
exercises.detail: Back stays glued to the floor. Regress before losing position.

card_templates.name: Core Day C
card_templates.summary: Oblique and lateral-chain work for single-leg stability.

payload.instructions: Core Day C targets obliques, adductors, and lateral stability. Stay tall and keep the work symmetrical side to side.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (high-to-low woodchop)
exercises.detail: Pull from high to opposite hip with hips square.

exercises.label: Copenhagen plank
exercises.detail: Build adductor strength without letting the pelvis collapse.

exercises.label: Suitcase carry
exercises.detail: Walk tall and resist lateral lean under asymmetric load.

exercises.label: Side plank + hip dip
exercises.detail: Control the dip and drive back up through the lateral chain.

card_templates.name: Core Day D
card_templates.summary: Dynamic rotation and power with full-body stability.

payload.instructions: Core Day D adds dynamic and power-oriented work. Stay explosive on the slams and deliberate on the stability lifts.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (low-to-high)
exercises.detail: Drive rotation through the trunk while feet stay planted.

exercises.label: Hanging windshield wipers
exercises.detail: Control the side-to-side rotation instead of swinging.

exercises.label: Med ball slams
exercises.detail: Use full hip extension up top and aggressive hip flexion on the slam.

exercises.label: Turkish get-up
exercises.detail: Pause through every checkpoint and own each transition.

card_templates.name: Supporting Block 1
card_templates.summary: Glutes and hip stability support for distance running.

payload.instructions: Supporting Block 1 builds glute medius, hip extension, and hip-flexor integration. Treat it as low-friction support work, not a max-effort session.

exercises.label: Banded clamshells
exercises.detail: Pause at the top without rolling the hips back.

exercises.label: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.detail: Drive through the heel and finish with full hip extension.

exercises.label: Lateral band walks
exercises.detail: Stay low and keep constant band tension.

exercises.label: Banded marching
exercises.detail: Drive the knee without leaning back.

card_templates.name: Supporting Block 2
card_templates.summary: Lower-leg stiffness and foot control for running economy.

payload.instructions: Supporting Block 2 builds calf, soleus, tibialis, and foot-intrinsic resilience. Tempo and range matter more than load early on.

exercises.label: Heavy slow calf raises (straight leg)
exercises.detail: Use full range with a controlled 3s up / 3s down tempo.

exercises.label: Bent-knee calf raises
exercises.detail: Keep the same tempo to load the soleus.

exercises.label: Tib raises
exercises.detail: Lift the toes toward the shins without rushing the reps.

exercises.label: Short foot / single-leg balance
exercises.detail: Build arch control and balance without curling the toes.

card_templates.name: Supporting Block 3
card_templates.summary: Eccentric hamstring, single-leg hinge, and reactive support work.

payload.instructions: Supporting Block 3 is the highest-cost support block. Keep the eccentric work slow and stop short of technical failure.

exercises.label: Nordic hamstring curls
exercises.detail: Lower as slowly as possible and use the hands to catch as needed.

exercises.label: Single-leg RDL
exercises.detail: Keep hips square and own the balance challenge.

exercises.label: Standing knee drives (banded)
exercises.detail: Drive the knee fast without losing posture.

exercises.label: Adductor squeeze
exercises.detail: Build groin resilience with controlled squeezes.

routine_specs.name: Two-Week Core Foundation
routine_specs.notes: Deterministic two-week core rotation imported from the proper bundle spec. Breathwork and experiments remain outside this routine.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 1 after morning breathwork, before intervals. Activation only at RPE 5-6; skip the fourth exercise on this hard day.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (horizontal)
exercises.detail: Start light and find the pattern. The eccentric return is where the transfer to running lives.

exercises.label: Pallof press
exercises.detail: Skip the overhead reach today. Press out, hold 2s, return, and learn the base anti-rotation pattern first.

exercises.label: Dead bugs
exercises.detail: Press the low back into the floor before moving limbs. Reduce range if the back arches.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 2 easy run morning. Full core dose today and keep trunk position strict instead of chasing range.

exercises.label: Ab wheel rollouts
exercises.detail: From knees. Stop at the furthest point you can return from without back sagging.

exercises.label: Hanging leg raises
exercises.detail: Start with knee raises if needed. Initiate by posteriorly tilting the pelvis.

exercises.label: Body saw plank
exercises.detail: Use a tiny range. You should feel the anti-extension demand immediately.

exercises.label: Hollow body hold
exercises.detail: Arms by your sides if needed. Bend knees if the back lifts.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Week 1 Tuesday adds Supporting Block 1 after Core Day B. Keep the support work easy enough to build patterns cleanly.

exercises.label: Banded clamshells
exercises.detail: Light band, controlled tempo, and a pause at the top.

exercises.label: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.detail: Drive through the heel and reset if the hamstring starts cramping.

exercises.label: Lateral band walks
exercises.detail: Stay in a quarter squat and keep the band under tension.

exercises.label: Banded marching
exercises.detail: Fight the urge to lean back as the knee drives up.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 3 tempo morning. Reduced hard-day dose; skip the suitcase carry and keep the work crisp.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (high-to-low woodchop)
exercises.detail: Use the same load as Day 1 horizontal rotations and learn the diagonal vector.

exercises.label: Copenhagen plank
exercises.detail: Bend the top knee on the bench if needed. Even an 8s hold counts on first exposure.

exercises.label: Side plank + hip dip
exercises.detail: Prioritize pelvic-drop resistance over speed.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 4 easy run morning. Full Core Day D exposure with deliberate setup on every new movement.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (low-to-high)
exercises.detail: Third cable vector. Let the change in angle shift the feel without rushing the reps.

exercises.label: Hanging windshield wipers
exercises.detail: Use bent knees if straight legs are not controllable yet.

exercises.label: Med ball slams
exercises.detail: This is the one explosive drill in the rotation. Be aggressive.

exercises.label: Turkish get-up
exercises.detail: Use no weight or a very light dumbbell and pause at each checkpoint.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Week 1 Thursday adds lower-leg and foot support work after Core Day D.

exercises.label: Heavy slow calf raises (straight leg)
exercises.detail: Bodyweight only this week, 3s up and 3s down through full range.

exercises.label: Bent-knee calf raises
exercises.detail: Match the tempo to bias the soleus.

exercises.label: Tib raises
exercises.detail: Stand on the heels and lift the toes without rushing.

exercises.label: Short foot / single-leg balance
exercises.detail: Just stand on one leg and build arch control without closing the eyes yet.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 5 rest day. This is the first full Core Day A with the fourth exercise included.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (horizontal)
exercises.detail: Second exposure. Add weight next time only if the pattern already feels natural.

exercises.label: Pallof press + overhead reach
exercises.detail: Add the overhead reach now, but shorten the range if the ribs flare.

exercises.label: Dead bugs
exercises.detail: Increase reps only if low-back contact stays solid.

exercises.label: Plank shoulder taps
exercises.detail: Use shoulder-width feet and narrow only when hip sway stays minimal.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Rest day support block 1 progression. Keep it smooth rather than fatiguing.

exercises.label: Banded clamshells
exercises.detail: Add a 2s pause at the top of every rep.

exercises.label: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.detail: Add 3 extra reps on the weaker side if one side clearly lags.

exercises.label: Lateral band walks
exercises.detail: Stay low and consistent on every step.

exercises.label: Banded marching
exercises.detail: Maintain upright posture against the band tension.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Rest day adds the second support block as part of the biggest Week 1 session.

exercises.label: Heavy slow calf raises (straight leg)
exercises.detail: Same full-range tempo focus as Day 4.

exercises.label: Bent-knee calf raises
exercises.detail: Same soleus emphasis as Day 4.

exercises.label: Tib raises
exercises.detail: Increase reps but keep the movement strict.

exercises.label: Short foot / single-leg balance
exercises.detail: Add 5s to the hold and keep the arch active.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 6 long-run morning. Reduced activation dose only; skip the hollow hold.

exercises.label: Ab wheel rollouts
exercises.detail: Notice whether your rollout range has increased since Day 2.

exercises.label: Hanging leg raises
exercises.detail: Try straight-leg on the first set if knee raises were necessary on Day 2.

exercises.label: Body saw plank
exercises.detail: Exhale as you saw forward into the hardest position.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 7 easy run morning. Full Core Day C plus the first exposure to Supporting Block 3.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (high-to-low woodchop)
exercises.detail: Increase reps from Day 3 while keeping hips square.

exercises.label: Copenhagen plank
exercises.detail: Stay at the same hold and judge whether stability is already improving.

exercises.label: Suitcase carry
exercises.detail: Use a heavy but walkable dumbbell and move slowly.

exercises.label: Side plank + hip dip
exercises.detail: Control the 2s down / 1s up tempo.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 7 introduces the most demanding support block. Keep the eccentrics controlled and stop well before technical failure.

exercises.label: Nordic hamstring curls
exercises.detail: Lower as slowly as possible, catch with the hands, and push back up.

exercises.label: Single-leg RDL
exercises.detail: Bodyweight only and keep the hips square to the floor.

exercises.label: Standing knee drives (banded)
exercises.detail: Drive the knee fast and controlled against the band.

exercises.label: Adductor squeeze
exercises.detail: Use a ball squeeze or Copenhagen-lite variation and build the pattern.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 8 hard intervals. Reduced hard-day dose stays in place; skip the Turkish get-up.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (low-to-high)
exercises.detail: Increase reps from Day 4 while keeping the trunk-driven rotation crisp.

exercises.label: Hanging windshield wipers
exercises.detail: Try one straight-leg set if bent-knee reps are now under control.

exercises.label: Med ball slams
exercises.detail: Push aggression on the slam, not sloppiness.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 9 easy run. Full Core Day A with the first 3-set exposure and more total support volume.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (horizontal)
exercises.detail: Third exposure. Add 5 lbs if 3x8 already felt comfortable.

exercises.label: Pallof press + overhead reach
exercises.detail: Move to 3 sets and shorten the overhead range if the ribs still flare.

exercises.label: Dead bugs
exercises.detail: Hold at 2 sets but slow the tempo to 3s out / 3s back.

exercises.label: Plank shoulder taps
exercises.detail: Narrow the stance slightly if Day 5 felt stable.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Week 2 Tuesday rotates in Blocks 2 and 3 after Core Day A.

exercises.label: Heavy slow calf raises (straight leg)
exercises.detail: Move to 3 sets and add light dumbbells if bodyweight is too easy.

exercises.label: Bent-knee calf raises
exercises.detail: Same 3-set progression for the soleus-focused work.

exercises.label: Tib raises
exercises.detail: Keep this as maintenance volume.

exercises.label: Short foot / single-leg balance
exercises.detail: Reach the full target hold time with clean balance.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Week 2 Tuesday adds the eccentric and single-leg support block after lower-leg work.

exercises.label: Nordic hamstring curls
exercises.detail: Add one rep only if you can keep the eccentric slow.

exercises.label: Single-leg RDL
exercises.detail: Add 2 reps but keep it bodyweight until balance is solid.

exercises.label: Standing knee drives (banded)
exercises.detail: Add 2 reps without losing posture.

exercises.label: Adductor squeeze
exercises.detail: Add 2 reps and keep the squeeze controlled.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 10 tempo morning. Reduced hard-day anti-extension dose continues.

exercises.label: Ab wheel rollouts
exercises.detail: Your range should now be noticeably better than Day 2.

exercises.label: Hanging leg raises
exercises.detail: Use straight legs for both sets if possible and control the descent for 2s.

exercises.label: Body saw plank
exercises.detail: Increase the range slightly while keeping the core locked.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 11 easy run. Full Core Day C with more total volume and both support blocks 1 and 3.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (high-to-low woodchop)
exercises.detail: Move to 3 sets and add load if the current weight is comfortable.

exercises.label: Copenhagen plank
exercises.detail: Add 5s and try one straight-leg set if bent-knee holds are solid.

exercises.label: Suitcase carry
exercises.detail: Increase distance and walk slower than Day 7.

exercises.label: Side plank + hip dip
exercises.detail: Move to 3 sets while keeping the tempo controlled.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Week 2 Thursday brings back glute and hip-stability support alongside Core Day C.

exercises.label: Banded clamshells
exercises.detail: Upgrade the band only if the current resistance feels easy.

exercises.label: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.detail: Recheck whether one side still feels weaker.

exercises.label: Lateral band walks
exercises.detail: Keep the same controlled pattern as Day 5.

exercises.label: Banded marching
exercises.detail: Same stable marching pattern as Day 5.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Week 2 Thursday keeps Supporting Block 3 at the same prescription while quality catches up to the new reps.

exercises.label: Nordic hamstring curls
exercises.detail: Do not increase until every rep has at least a 3s eccentric.

exercises.label: Single-leg RDL
exercises.detail: Repeat the bodyweight hinge with square hips.

exercises.label: Standing knee drives (banded)
exercises.detail: Repeat the 10-rep dose with posture intact.

exercises.label: Adductor squeeze
exercises.detail: Repeat the 10-rep dose cleanly.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 12 rest day is the biggest session in the program. Push volume here, not on training days.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (low-to-high)
exercises.detail: Move to 3 sets and add load if the current weight is comfortable.

exercises.label: Hanging windshield wipers
exercises.detail: The third set is where rotational control gets tested.

exercises.label: Med ball slams
exercises.detail: Stay aggressive and crisp for all 3 sets.

exercises.label: Turkish get-up
exercises.detail: Add light load only if the bodyweight pattern is already clean.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 12 includes all three support blocks. Keep Block 1 smooth so fatigue stays budgeted for the whole session.

exercises.label: Banded clamshells
exercises.detail: Same controlled clamshell pattern as prior exposures.

exercises.label: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.detail: Same full hip-extension focus as prior exposures.

exercises.label: Lateral band walks
exercises.detail: Same controlled band-walk pattern as prior exposures.

exercises.label: Banded marching
exercises.detail: Same marching pattern as prior exposures.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 12 lower-leg block. This is the day to add load and a harder balance variation.

exercises.label: Heavy slow calf raises (straight leg)
exercises.detail: Add 5 lbs from Day 9 if the earlier load was manageable.

exercises.label: Bent-knee calf raises
exercises.detail: Match the straight-leg progression for the soleus work.

exercises.label: Tib raises
exercises.detail: Keep this as maintenance volume.

exercises.label: Short foot / single-leg balance
exercises.detail: Try closing the eyes for the final 10s of each set.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 12 is the first 3-set Nordic exposure. Expect soreness tomorrow and stop before losing control.

exercises.label: Nordic hamstring curls
exercises.detail: This is the first 12-rep total eccentric exposure in the program.

exercises.label: Single-leg RDL
exercises.detail: Add a light dumbbell only if balance is solid without it.

exercises.label: Standing knee drives (banded)
exercises.detail: Repeat the 10-rep dose with fast, controlled drives.

exercises.label: Adductor squeeze
exercises.detail: Repeat the 10-rep dose and keep the squeeze clean.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 13 long-run morning. Back to reduced-dose activation using the same weight as Day 9.

exercises.label: Cable rotations (horizontal)
exercises.detail: Use Day 9's weight and do not add load before the long run.

exercises.label: Pallof press + overhead reach
exercises.detail: Standard reduced-dose anti-rotation work.

exercises.label: Dead bugs
exercises.detail: Stay slow and reinforce the contralateral pattern before the run.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 14 easy run. This is the assessment day for how far anti-extension capacity moved in two weeks.

exercises.label: Ab wheel rollouts
exercises.detail: Compare your rollout range directly to Day 2.

exercises.label: Hanging leg raises
exercises.detail: Full target dose with straight legs and controlled descent.

exercises.label: Body saw plank
exercises.detail: Increase range to 6+ inches if the core stays locked.

exercises.label: Hollow body hold
exercises.detail: Arms overhead only if the back stays down for the full hold.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 14 final Supporting Block 1 exposure. Use it to note whether resistance and asymmetry need attention in Weeks 3-4.

exercises.label: Banded clamshells
exercises.detail: If this is too easy, move up a band next block.

exercises.label: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.detail: Make a final left-right comparison and log any asymmetry.

exercises.label: Lateral band walks
exercises.detail: Standard controlled band walks.

exercises.label: Banded marching
exercises.detail: Standard upright marching pattern.

prescription_override_json.instructions: Day 14 final lower-leg block. Use it to judge whether the next phase should increase load or balance difficulty.

exercises.label: Heavy slow calf raises (straight leg)
exercises.detail: Final session at this load. Increase load in Weeks 3-4 if this feels stable.

exercises.label: Bent-knee calf raises
exercises.detail: Same assessment for the soleus-focused work.

exercises.label: Tib raises
exercises.detail: Maintenance dose.

exercises.label: Short foot / single-leg balance
exercises.detail: Close the eyes for the full 30s if balance now allows it.
